description: Education, research experience, professional work, freelancing, and volunteering by Md. Muhaiminul Islam (Jamee).
heading: Education & Experience

entries.title: Rajshahi University of Engineering & Technology (RUET)
entries.role: B.Sc. (Engg.) in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering
entries.summary: Thesis: A Multi-Modal Robotic Framework for Real-Time Waste Detection and Categorization Using SLAM, IoT, and Convolutional Neural Networks

entries.title: Department of Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering, RUET
bullets: Designed an autonomous garbage detection and collection robot using Raspberry Pi, YOLOv5/Faster R-CNN-based object detection, and SLAM-based navigation with LiDAR-GPS fusion and Kalman filtering/A* path planning, achieving 97% detection accuracy for trash and 96% for non-trash items, with 97% precision and 98% recall.

Engineered a GPS-GSM-based landmine and human-detection robot integrating Arduino, ESP32-CAM, and multi-sensor (PIR, gas, sonar, metal-detection) hardware, and an autonomous self-driving car using ROS and YOLO-based object recognition with real-time English–Bangla road-text translation, enabling remote hazard alerting and improved human–machine interaction across both platforms.

Architected an AI-based smart notice board with a three-tier full-stack system (Python, Node.js, MySQL) for real-time facial identification and personalized content delivery, achieving 97% accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score in facial recognition evaluation.
Developed a real-time hand-gesture recognition system for human–machine interaction using deep learning-based classification models, achieving a 99.0% macro-F1 score.

Investigated an advanced Fresnel algorithm for computer-generated holography to improve image quality in secure communication systems, optimizing Fresnel distance and operating wavelength (350–700 nm) to minimize ringing and blurring, and achieved a muxed-hologram entropy of 7.99 (near the ideal 8-bit maximum), confirming high-fidelity, low correlation secure image reconstruction.

entries.title: THT-Space Electrical Company Ltd.
bullets: Engineered an 8-command hand gesture recognition system using a 76-dimensional landmark feature extractor and 128–64 MLP architecture, trained on 36,864 samples across 9 classes, and optimized with augmentation, runtime rejection, ONNX inference, and temporal gating to achieve 98.8% known-command acceptance, 99.0% macro-F1, and 0.4% unknown false-accept rate on 3,631 public-test observations.
Designed and developed embedded firmware in C/C++ for microcontroller-based systems, including thermal and dot matrix printers, biometric IoT devices, and AI-powered embedded applications.

Designed embedded hardware, mixed-signal circuits, schematics, and multilayer PCBs using Altium Designer and KiCad, including component selection, BOM optimization, prototyping, and hardware validation.
Configured and optimized GPIO, Timers, PWM, ADC, UART, SPI, and I²C, while integrating sensors, actuators, wireless modules, and TinyML & Edge AI solutions for resource-constrained devices.
